'''Ludogorets II''' ({{langx|bg|Лудогорец II}}) or '''Ludogorets 2''' is a [[Bulgaria]]n professional football team based in [[Razgrad]]. Founded in 2015, it is the [[reserve team]] of [[PFC Ludogorets Razgrad]], and currently plays in [[Bulgarian B Professional Football Group|Second League]], the second level of Bulgarian football.

Obliged to play one level below their main side, Ludogorets II is ineligible for promotion to [[Bulgarian A Football Group|First League]] and also cannot compete in the [[Bulgarian Cup]]."}}
